findings.reader: A well-bounded launch report: it names the September 10 developer release, makes the model-versus-harness split genuinely explanatory through one honestly labeled hypothetical errand, and converts three documented boundaries (completed ≠ succeeded, no-fee ≠ free, environment ≠ retention) into a specific, transferable verification habit. Voice is warm and adult, terms are defined in context, uncertainty about reliability and adoption survives, and both the explain-back and an invented bookkeeping transfer scenario resolve correctly from the article's mechanism alone.
findings.facts: Every material claim — September 10 public beta, managed-harness split, all-developer availability, completion caveat, separate billing, US-only residency and no-ZDR retention — matches the supplied OpenAI launch and documentation excerpts with correct attribution. Vendor-evidence limits are stated explicitly in P003 and the personal-life example is clearly labeled hypothetical. No factual defect found.
